selection_metric_primary: lowest validation review_adjusted_cost with review_cost=0.5, FN=5, FP=1
selection_metric_secondary: manual_review_rate<=0.25 preferred, then high_risk_precision, low_risk_default_rate, auto_decision_rate
selection_reason: Locked manual-review policy because false-positive reduction requires screening/manual review. Binary winner is Old SCRE-Credit (precision_constrained_threshold) with validation binary cost=3224.0, but binary cost is not directly comparable to review-adjusted cost. Manual winner is Best CatBoost with review-adjusted cost=2650.5, MR rate=0.297. SCRE is retained separately as research framework if it is not the operational winner.
manual_review_cost_assumption: review_adjusted_cost = auto_FP*fp_cost + auto_FN*fn_cost + manual_review_count*review_cost; manual decisions assumed correct for Track 2 selection
